scientific_integrity: An analytical proof is given for the claimed limits and quantitative bound. The included finite numerical checks are supplementary, not proofs of infinite claims. Direct prior overlap and implicit-coverage risks are disclosed. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Brownian diffusion on a fixed circle with one absorbing target, independent Poisson resetting and fresh location sampling. General joint law assumes two target-side powers of the same exponent; the explicit total-variation bound requires a symmetric exact power profile. Finite-clock measurement, moving targets, correlations of resets and non-Poisson resetting are outside scope. The general final-reset-position weighting, mean-time identity and unmarked frequent-reset exponential limit are credited as prior results.
title: Universal successful-excursion marks and an exponentially accurate ring-to-line approximation
